nodes.label: Move to System.IO.Compression
nodes.rationale: As part of the .NET Core port, Evolution replaced the original .NET 2/Mono-era compression handling with the standard .NET Core library System.IO.Compression, enabling the library to run on .NET Core without Mono-specific dependencies.
